Trace, implement and test: leetcode1104 path in zigzag labelled binary tree sol2 using bit op

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> pathInZigZagTree(int label) {
        vector<int> res;   
        int i = 2; 
        int level = 0;    // 计算label所在层的level index
        while (i <= label)
        {
            i *= 2;
            level++;
        }        
        res.push_back(label);        
        while (level > 0)
        {
            int level_min = 1 << level;
            int level_max = (1 << (level + 1)) - 1;
            label = (level_min + level_max - label) / 2;
            res.push_back(label);
            
            level--;
        }
        reverse(res.begin(), res.end());        
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    auto res = sol.pathInZigZagTree(12);
    for (auto x : res)
        cout << x << " ";

    return 0;
}
